days.title: 작은 산 – 백비치
days.morning: Leave Saigon and climb to the Christ the King statue on Small Mountain.
days.afternoon: Swim at Back Beach and walk to Hon Ba at low tide.
days.evening: Bánh khọt, stingray hotpot and a stroll along Front Beach.

days.evening: Stay at a Ho Tram resort.

days.title: 빈쩌우 – 프억브우 숲

days.afternoon: Boil eggs in the hot springs and take a mineral mud bath.
days.evening: Back to Vung Tau and buy salted egg sponge cake.
